parameters.name: d365_url
parameters.label: Dynamics 365 environment URL
parameters.helpText: For example https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com (no path, no trailing slash)

parameters.name: call_tag
parameters.label: Call ticket tag
parameters.helpText: Tickets with this tag are opened for the agent. Must match the tag set by the Dynamics 365 flow.

parameters.name: popup_max_age_minutes
parameters.label: Open tickets newer than (minutes)
parameters.helpText: Only tickets created within this time are opened automatically.
